## Disposition

Accept the revised scoped partial results for external-ray rotation, target 5300074: continuity on the strictly repelling marked locus; density of the smooth-ray domain and uniqueness of any continuous extension; the connected-Julia neutral-boundary limit; and the exact obstruction to the multiplier-argument shortcut.

The 5/5 substantive-approach budget is exhausted. Disconnected-Julia neutral-boundary continuity, including singleton components and irrational rotation, and compatibility at every initially accessible indifferent point remain gaps. No full solution, full counterexample, complete prior resolution, sixth approach, or novelty claim is made.

## Proof corrections and provenance

Current RESULT.md is the accepted reviewed text, SHA-256 b1cbc9b5b77060b8ba57faabcd7927d49df6579a1381ef6dea95b750a2790be1. It retains the explicit positive-potential persistence proof and normalized invariant-Beltrami wringing construction. The finite cyclic-shift formula requires a cyclic-order-preserving permutation; arbitrary finite forward invariance is insufficient. There are 616 enumerated cases and 150 distinct degree/angle-set pairs.

The full independent authored audit and contextual authored correction patch are included. Removed patch text is superseded. The full old report, historical runner and execution receipts, source PDF/text, dataset/corpus content and private coordination are excluded. Public source verification is metadata only; local PDF hashes/sizes were freshly matched without redistributing their contents or claiming a fresh download.

## Verification

The original exact checkers are copied unchanged. A new deterministic guarded runner explicitly requires every named baseline test: all five original tests and all four independent tests, zero errors/skips/expected failures/unexpected successes. It also checks exact 616/150 and 238/423 enumeration outputs. Six negative controls reject empty, incomplete, skipped, erroneous, expected-failure and unexpected-success suites.

All 11 intended semantic mutants are rejected in normal, -O and -OO, including restoring the erroneous negative fixture. The floor-to-truncation mutant must produce its specific degree-one RuntimeError in the named test; a generic runtime/import/syntax error cannot qualify. All other mutant kills use the intended named assertion failures. No finite test certifies the analytic dynamical proofs.

Final controls passed in all three optimization modes as actual UID=EUID=1000 with files 0444, directory 0555, 36 whole-delivery physical write denials and 20 mathematical-fixture denials per mode. Per mode: 52 integrity negatives, 77 schema/scope negatives, 19 direct-comparator negatives, 11 semantic mutants, six invalid-suite negatives, and complete hostile-environment baseline equality. Full fresh stdout/stderr is compared byte-for-byte, recursively type-exact and without normalization. Whole-delivery and fixture hashes are unchanged.

Pre-seal receipts are labeled and bound by the final manifest. The final fixed-bootstrap receipts are external to avoid circular self-hashes. Historical original-report/runner/receipt replay, historical patch application, source-body replay, dataset replay and formal proof-assistant verification are NOT_RUN. The standalone unittest.main entrypoint is not replayed; the guarded runner executes every original named test itself.
